people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

translations.web: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
translations.bsb: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
translations.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
translations.asv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and see that out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
